models.title: Covariance from a finite joint distribution
models.summary: Covariance sums paired centered deviations weighted by their joint probabilities across the full joint support.

relationship.translation_notes: Each term hasU*V because probability is dimensionless. No n-1 divisor: this is distribution covariance, scientifically distinct from the sample estimator. Sparse zero-probability cells contribute0 and may be omitted if full-support accounting is documented. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.

models.title: Variance of a fixed-weight portfolio
models.summary: Portfolio return variance is the weight-covariance quadratic form, including cross-asset co-movement terms.

relationship.translation_notes: Exact flattened quadratic form, with either both ordered off-diagonals or one doubled representative but never both conventions together. The two-asset form w1^2*v1+w2^2*v2+2*w1*w2*cov12 is a qualified case of this same record. Decimal returns are dimensionless; percent-squared references are normalized once during binding. Owner-PDF locator is retained on the project-derivation citation; the relationship source is the accessible corroboration.

variables.definition: All ordered covariance contributions, or equivalently diagonal terms and doubled unique off-diagonal terms, for one portfolio
variables.context: Same portfolio weights, asset universe, return horizon, currency basis and coherent covariance matrix

variables.definition: Variance of the fixed-weight portfolio return
variables.context: Same portfolio and moment convention as terms

assumptions: Source assumption: deterministic weights and all asset moments share the same horizon and return definition; source portfolio weights sum to1.
Covariance matrix is symmetric positive semidefinite; short positions may create signed cross contributions.
limitations: Precomputed contributions must preserve weights and matrix provenance; sum positivity alone cannot establish matrix coherence.
Full raw matrix operations are outside the scalar grammar. At most256 supplied contributions per evaluation; larger exact sums require explicit aggregation outside this record.
